segments.translation_text: It is difficult to obtain a body with leisure and endowment and it is even rarer for virtuous thoughts of Dharma to arise. Even when they arise they do not last long. Therefore, the virtue that orients beings toward meritorious deeds is like the appearance of lightning because it occurs only once in a while. Thus the power of virtue remains always feeble.

segments.translation_text: Wise ones wish to eliminate hundreds of samsaric sufferings such as falling into hell and the like, and they engage in the methods of doing so. They also wish to dispel various types of unhappiness for all sentient beings, such as the difficult experiences of birth, old age, and death. Also, they wish to experience hundreds of temporary and permanent types of joy for themselves and other beings. The certain method of accomplishing these things is to never forsake any aspect of enlightenment thought, and to hold it firmly.

segments.translation_text: If the special enlightenment thought arises, at the minute it arises, those who experience difficulty due to a multitude of sufferings from being tightly bound by karma and defilements in the shackles of the prison of samsara will have their names changed. They will be known as Bodhisattvas, Sons of the Sugatas. Not only their names, but the actual meaning of their lives will be changed. They will become the objects of prostration, veneration, and respect by multitudes of worldly beings, including humans, demigods, and gods.

Like the supreme gold-making elixir.
It transforms this impure body we have taken
Into the priceless jewel of a Buddha's body.

segments.translation_text: Noble Son, here I shall explain the metaphor. There is a type of mercury called manifest gold. One gram of this mercury can transmute a thousand grams of iron into gold. But a thousand grams of iron can neither transmute one gram of mercury into iron, nor can it exhaust it. Likewise, the root of virtue of the thought of completely dedicating oneself to attain omniscient Buddhahood, which is sealed by primordial wisdom, can exhaust all of the iron of karma and the defilements, and all phenomena can be transformed into the color of perfect gold. Only the elixir of the enlightenment thought of the Omniscient Ones is unable to be exhausted by all the karma and defilements, nor can it be transformed into defilement.

segments.translation_text: All other worldly and beyond-worldly virtues that are not associated with enlightenment mind are like a plantain tree, which once it produces fruit is exhausted and does not produce fruit again. Such a virtue produces its own specific ripening result, which is similar to merit, and then it is exhausted. It is said that the virtues of even Arhats and Prateka Buddhas become exhausted when they reach the state in which no aggregates remain.

segments.translation_text: Relying on a brave person as an escort will quickly liberate a traveler on a dangerous and terrifying journey. Likewise, by relying on enlightenment thought, those who have indulged in the five heinous sins, the extremely heavy result of which is the experience of the sufferings of hell and the like, will find that before too long, the obscurations are exhausted and they will be liberated from suffering by this very powerful antidote. Therefore, why would the heedful not rely upon enlightenment thought? It is suitable and right to rely upon it.

segments.translation_text: Once engaging enlightenment thought is born, from that time forward, one’s wish and purpose is to completely liberate all those limitless sentient beings who experience the samsaric suffering of the three defilements. segments.translation_text: The great benefactors, the Bodhisattvas, strive to satisfy limitless beings beyond number with the excellent gift of the unsurpassable happiness of the Bliss-Gone Buddhas, not for a short duration, but for limitless time until samsara is emptied in a manner that is peaceful, tamed, and respectful. They especially wish to benefit every sentient being by fulfilling their every need and desire without exception, and to give in this way always without interruption. Such supreme benefactors as the Bodhisattvas are worthy of veneration and praise.

segments.translation_text: Enlightenment thought arises from a holy mind like a wish-fulfilling jewel which bestows every wish and removes every degeneration. It is suitable to make endless devoted prostrations with body, voice, and mind to the holy bodies of those who possess such a noble mind.

segments.translation_text: Bodhisattvas bestow happiness on anyone who makes a positive connection with them. From their great compassion, they also make a connection to bestow temporary and ultimate benefit even upon those who hate or harm them. Thus, they are a source of happiness for all. One should accept such noble beings as a refuge, and make a commitment to rely upon and trust them as objects of refuge.

segments.translation_text: It is not a contradiction to state that by generating evil thoughts toward the Noble Ones, beings will fall into hell. Also, it is not a contradiction to state that they will eventually be placed in great happiness by the power of the aspirations and skillful means of those who possess great compassion. Therefore always remember the benefits of enlightenment thought and practice devotion toward those who possess such a mind.
